home.title: Reunite lost documents with their owners
home.subtitle: Report a document you found or lost. We look for matches and tell you which police station to visit.

found.title: I found a document
found.text: Report it and tell us which police station you dropped it at.

lost.title: I lost a document
lost.text: Tell us what you lost and we will notify you when it turns up.

report.title: Report
report.text: Describe the document you found or lost.

match.title: We match
match.text: We compare reports and alert you about a possible match.

collect.title: Collect
collect.text: Go to the police station, where an officer checks your identity.

home.note: RetroDoc never decides who owns a document. The police station always verifies.

step1.title: Report a lost document
step1.text: Tell us about the document you lost.

step2.title: Report a found document
step2.text: If you find a document, report it and deposit it at the selected police station.

step3.title: Possible match
step3.text: RetroDoc compares lost and found reports and alerts the possible owner.

step4.title: Confirm the match
step4.text: The possible owner reviews the information and confirms whether the document may be theirs.

step5.title: Station verification
step5.text: A police officer verifies the owner's identity and supporting proof before releasing the document.

safety.title: Safety tips
safety.privacy: Only provide information needed to identify the document.
safety.codes: Keep your drop-off and collection codes private.
safety.proof: Bring valid identification or supporting proof when collecting a document.
safety.ownership: A possible match does not automatically prove ownership.
